models.name: Ministral 3 3B
models.summary: The assistant's model, chosen after comparing four small models on Spectra's own scenarios: it calls checks reliably and answers from what the app found. Fluent in Russian, although Russian is not officially supported.

models.name: EmbeddingGemma 300M
models.summary: Not for chatting: it helps the web search find the right parts of pages by meaning, not only by matching words. In our trials it found the answer in all 16 cases, against 14 for matching words alone. Needs web search turned on.
